title: THE BELT HINT READS ON ANY GROUND
why: Seen on the 4K fog screenshot of 2026-10-08: the line over the belt (the item name, [FIRE] use, [V] signal) was grey text straight on the ground, so on pale ground (fog, sand, a lit floor) it all but vanished. It now sits on a soft dark strip and is a little brighter, at the same size and place.
now: The hint over the belt is readable on pale ground and in fog.
